messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need a clear operational rule for SI co-sell routing when leads come from multiple sources (marketplace listing, SI intro, direct SDR). Two deals this week had ownership friction. @Owen @Lina any quick takes?

Owen Patel: +1. We should prioritize by source attribution + earliest validated touch. Proposal: marketplace-origin wins unless SI has an explicit signed engagement doc. For SI intros: first qualified meeting timestamp = tie-breaker.

Lina Gomez: I sketched a compact matrix — small, machine-readable rules we can push to sync logic in our CRM/webhook. Idea: 3 columns: origin, required proof, owner. Example:
```
origin            | proof required                | owner
------------------|-------------------------------|----------------
marketplace       | marketplace order id OR PO    | marketplace rep
si-intro          | signed engagement email OR first meeting recorded | SI rep
direct-sdr        | standard qualification (BANT) | SDR rep
both (market+si)  | both touches exist             | marketplace by default; SI can claim within 48h with proof
```

Maya Chen: That 48h claim window is important. Also want an escalation path if both sides disagree after the window. Suggest escalate to Partnership Ops + Revenue Ops; freeze routing for 72h while reviewed.

Julian Park: CRM mapping notes — make sure "lead_source_detail" captures marketplace id and partner org id. If partner org id present AND marketplace id present, route per matrix. We can add a webhook that posts to #partnerships-escalations with suggested owner.

Owen Patel: One more: include a brief SLA for joint executive engagement for high ACV (> $250k). If SI can't produce an exec sponsor within 14 days, ownership reverts to Redwood AE to keep deal moving. Prevents stalls.

Lina Gomez: I can draft a minimal JSON policy for engineers to consume. Sample: 
```json
{"priority": ["marketplace","si-intro","direct-sdr"],"si_claim_window_hours":48,"escalation_channel":"partnerships-escalations","high_acv_revert_days":14}
```

partner-bot: Reminder: created issue #PRT-3427 "SI routing matrix implementation" and linked this thread. Assigned to @Lina.

Maya Chen: Nice. Action items: Lina — draft policy JSON + Confluence playbook by EOD Thu. Julian — confirm CRM field names and wire webhook. Owen — draft exec-engagement SLA language. I'll own the escalation triage flow.

Julian Park: Also recommend a simple email template for SIs to claim ownership (so Ops has consistent proof). Will post a draft here.

Lina Gomez: Posting draft in #partnerships-docs in a few hours. :rocket:

Maya Chen: Thanks team — this should cut down the finger-pointing. Will loop in RevOps once draft is in Confluence. :thumbsup:
